title: Create a Maturity Area on an explicitly approved test Orchard
description: Existing Orchard → effective-dated Grower Supplier link (if missing) → MA Details → exact Block → Review → Create and verify. Browser writes only.

coverage.capability: Create an MA with Grower Supplier prerequisite on an existing test Orchard

safety: Persistent writes: may add a Grower Supplier link and creates an MA. Requires mutations confirmation, test host, exact Orchard/Entity/Block identities; no automatic delete. NEVER included in capture:all.
prerequisites: Set maFixture.enabled and maFixture.allowExistingTestOrchard true, and configure exact Orchard PIN/name, existing Entity name/code, Block code, MA code and effective date.
Choose a KineX test host and a disposable test Orchard, with permissions to add grower links and create MAs.
Use selected NZ/KIWIFRUIT/2027 scope and a date within the Orchard season.
Ensure source Block is eligible and unassigned. Grower Supplier Entity must already exist and be active.

steps.heading: Select the approved existing Orchard
steps.instruction: Find the Orchard by exact PIN and name; refuse ambiguous or unrelated records.

steps.heading: Ensure an effective-dated Grower Supplier
steps.instruction: Reuse the precise Entity link if present; otherwise add that existing Entity through the Orchard Grower Suppliers tab.

steps.heading: Complete MA Details
steps.instruction: Open the MA wizard; enter the configured code, effective date, approved supplier and truck-access value.

steps.heading: Assign the configured Block and review
steps.instruction: Select only the specified eligible, unassigned Block, then review the MA before submission.

steps.heading: Create the MA and verify the saved record
steps.instruction: Record durable submission intent, click the real Create MA button and verify the saved MA code.
